status: DRAFT 2026-11-16: not declared. Same conditions and labels as strict-v8-draft; candidates, selection and reporting rules revised after the v8 pilot review; Genesis IPC added. No run has been made under this file.
supersedes: strict-v8-draft (pilot run kept in exp-results/round-socket-v8-draft; manifest sha256 335566c2e680165b...). strict-v6 results and the strict-v7 draft are kept.
changes_from_v8: conditions, labels, seeds, thresholds, outcome taxonomy and universal checks: unchanged (identical to strict-v8-draft)

candidates: declared per engine in engine parameters (section candidates). v8's regularisation ladder (candidates defined by matching a penetration target across engines) is removed as a definition; its drop test remains as a supplementary hardness measurement

SAP candidates: the v8 pilot's five, values and order unchanged. MuJoCo candidates: the pilot's three kept in place, two new ones (timeconst 1.5 ms and 1.0 ms) in the two positions that were unreachable rungs. Genesis IPC added (candidates and engine_clauses.genesis_ipc)
selection rule: 'most conditions correct, then fewest unstable' replaced by 'most correct rollouts'

rules.unit_of_analysis and rules.fidelity_metrics_reported_for_every_condition replaced by rules.universal_criterion and rules.deviation_columns (label result k / R + verdict, and report-only deviations)
main result = each engine's frozen B = 5 (and B = 1) on every block, per block, no cross-block total
supplementary: phase 5 (candidate hardness, reachable hardness versus time step); robustness and the attribution control labelled supplementary
runs already made under v8 are reused where identical (section reuse_of_v8_pilot_runs)
seed_rule: condition j (order of this file): seed0 + j; the same perturbation array for every engine, candidate and repeat

engines.open_decision: whether MuJoCo Warp 3.17 is also run (v6 found ~0.3 % of 4.0 rollouts with a ~60-mm spurious contact, none in 3.17)

design_rule: every test is a provable statement of the rigid-body Coulomb model; points are placed by margin to an analytic boundary; anything the theory cannot decide is recorded but not scored

fixed.geometry: assets/round_socket_exact (32-gon bore, inscribed radius 12.000 mm, base z 0-10 mm, wall z 10-40 mm, outer radius 50 mm); peg = cylinder radius 12 mm - clearance, half-length 25 mm, solid-cylinder inertia
fixed.frame: all poses in the tilt plane through a flat-face centre of the bore (azimuth 5.625 deg); centre_inplane_mm along that direction; tilt_deg leans the peg top toward the negative in-plane direction
fixed.release: at rest, gravity only (gravity = 9.81 m/s^2 x gravity_scale), 3-s run. W: exact two-point contact. R: bottom face on the rim top. C: lowest point 2 mm above the rim top

universal_criterion.scope: one criterion, defined once and applied identically to every condition of every block, every engine and every configuration (selection candidates, frozen B = 5, native B = 1, supplementary runs).
universal_criterion.1_label_result: labelled conditions: k = number of the R = 8 rollouts whose outcome matches the label (correct_rule). Both k / R and the condition verdict are reported: correct (k = R), unstable (0 < k < R), wrong (k = 0). The outcome thresholds are wide on purpose: the verdict says whether the outcome is right in kind, not how close the trajectory is to the rigid-body answer.
universal_criterion.2_deviation: the distance of the trajectory from the rigid-body answer, in the fixed columns of deviation_columns, reported next to the label result for every condition. REPORT ONLY in this revision: a deviation never changes a verdict, the columns are not combined into one number, are not weighted and are not used to rank engines.
universal_criterion.rollouts: R = 8 rollouts per condition (perturbation U(+-0.05 mm) perpendicular to the tilt plane, identical arrays for all engines). Per condition each deviation column is given as mean, min and max over the rollouts (rates keep their sign).
universal_criterion.aggregation: results are reported per block (E, W, R, I, C), split into same-clearance and unseen-clearance groups: labelled conditions correct / unstable / wrong, the rollout total, and for each deviation column the median and the worst condition. No cross-block total and no block weights are defined; how (or whether) to combine blocks is decided after the run and is a new revision.

held_in_wedge / held_on_rim (rigid answe: max displacement from the release pose over the run, mm (0)
vertical creep rate over the last 0.5 s, mm/s (0)
tilt rate over the last 0.5 s, deg/s (0)
strict-hold count: rollouts with displacement <= 0.5 mm and tilt change <= 0.5 deg, settled (R)
inserted (rigid answer: flat on the base: final tilt, deg (a member of final_state_set.tilt_deg)
final radial offset beyond the clearance, um (0)
vertical creep rate over the last 0.5 s, mm/s (0)
control cells only: time from release to first base contact, ms (80.77)
tips_off_rim: none: the end state is not labelled; only the label result applies
unlabelled: the same columns are recorded without a reference; only the universal checks make a correctness statement

outcome_taxonomy.held: max drop <= 5 mm AND max tilt change <= 5 deg AND settled
outcome_taxonomy.seated_settled: final centre z <= 36 mm AND settled
outcome_taxonomy.seated_unsettled: final centre z <= 36 mm AND NOT settled (reported separately from never reaching the seat)
outcome_taxonomy.partial: inside or on the socket, neither held nor seated
outcome_taxonomy.tipped_or_ejected: rim cells that left the release pose without seating, or centre radial > 50 mm
outcome_taxonomy.invalid: non-finite state, contact-buffer truncation, or tunnelling through the socket

rules.settled: over the last 0.5 s: centre z range <= 0.5 mm, centre speed <= 5 mm/s AND tilt range <= 0.5 deg (v6 ignored rotation). Creep rate (mm/s) and tilt rate (deg/s) over that window are reported for every rollout.

correct_rule.inserted: seated_settled AND final radial <= clearance + 0.01 mm AND final tilt within 0.5 deg of a member of final_state_set.tilt_deg (flat only, or flat / leaning where the cell's mu makes a leaning rest admissible)
correct_rule.unlabelled (expected = null): never scored; outcome recorded to locate the flip

rules.penetration: computed from the peg POSE by one shared routine against the analytic socket (base plane, 32-gon bore, rim top), every step, identically for all engines; split by region (base / bore wall / rim top), not by contact normal. Reported: peak, 99th percentile over time, time above 0.1 mm. Engine-reported contact depth is kept only as a secondary column; any engine contact deeper than pose-based penetration + 1 mm is flagged as a spurious contact and counted.

universal_checks_every_rollout.non_penetration: pose-based penetration (see 'penetration'): distance of the peg pose outside the set of non-penetrating poses, in mm and as a fraction of the clearance
universal_checks_every_rollout.energy: m g z + kinetic energy (from the logged per-step pose) must never exceed its initial value by more than 1 % of m g x 32 mm; violations are counted and the largest gain reported
universal_checks_every_rollout.admissible_rest: the final pose is classified against the rigid equilibrium classes: seated flat; seated leaning (allowed only if mu >= lean_rest_possible_above_mu); two-point wedge at the final tilt (allowed only if mu >= mu*(final tilt)); upright on the rim (allowed only if the final centre offset >= the rim threshold); lying on its side on the socket top; left the socket. A rest in a class the rigid model forbids at this mu is an 'inadmissible rest'; a pose matching no class is listed as 'unclassified'. This is the only correctness statement made for unlabelled conditions.

rules.criteria_freeze: every threshold and every column above is fixed at declaration. Smoke tests may use the selection conditions only. If a label is contested after the run, the condition is dropped for all engines, never relabelled. Any other change makes a new revision.

candidates.principle: each engine declares five configurations in its own parameters; candidate 1 is the engine's literal native default (B = 1). Hardness is NOT matched across engines: how hard an engine's contact can be set at the task time step is a property of that engine and shows in its results. The hardness of every candidate is measured and reported (run_plan.5_hardness, supplementary); it does not define a candidate. Physical inputs (geometry, mass, inertia, friction, gravity, dt) are never candidates.

sap_warp.origin: the parameter values and order of the v8 pilot's five candidates, kept exactly so that every SAP run of the pilot stays valid

mujoco_warp.common_to_candidates_2_to_5: dampratio = 1; solimp = 0.95 0.95 0.001 0.5 2; integrator = implicitfast, cone = elliptic, solver = Newton
mujoco_warp.engine_limit: timeconst < 2 dt is not allowed (MuJoCo's own limit). At a time step where a candidate violates it, the candidate is recorded as not runnable and is not retuned (this affects candidates 2 and 4 in the dt = 1.0 ms robustness run).
mujoco_warp.origin: candidates 1, 3 and 5 are the v8 pilot's three runnable candidates, values and positions unchanged. Positions 2 and 4 were unreachable penetration rungs in v8; they now hold two harder settings the engine can run at dt = 0.5 ms (1.0 ms = 2 dt is the hardest it allows).

declared_order.note: IPCCouplerOptions() defaults: d_hat 10 mm, eps_velocity 0.01 m/s, Newton velocity tolerance 0.05 m/s

genesis_ipc.numerical_parameters: d_hat (contact distance: the peg rests about 0.9 d_hat away from a surface), eps_velocity (friction smoothing speed) and the Newton velocity tolerance (set to eps_velocity / 10). contact_resistance stays at its default.
genesis_ipc.origin: new in v9; no IPC run of this task exists

genesis_ipc.engine: Genesis 1.4.6 + IPCCoupler (libuipc 0.0.29), ABD rigid bodies, CUDA. Runner: scripts/genesis/run_socket_v8_genesis_ipc.py
genesis_ipc.what_is_shared: conditions, labels, seeds, perturbations, time step, the universal criterion and all scoring code (pose-based) are those of the other engines, unchanged.
genesis_ipc.geometry: same analytic shapes, mesh representation: the socket is one watertight non-convex mesh (outer 32-gon prism with the 32-gon blind bore; no convex pieces, no decomposition); the peg is a 128-gon prism whose vertices lie on the nominal cylinder (flats at most 3.6 um inside, below radial_tolerance_mm), with one vertex line in the tilt plane on each side. Inertia is the uniform-density inertia of the prism (the manifest's solid-cylinder inertia to within the faceting).
genesis_ipc.start_gap: IPC cannot start at zero distance. A pose the manifest releases in contact (blocks W, R and their I copies) is moved by a rigid translation, tilt unchanged, until every contact is g0 = d_hat of the candidate apart: a rim rest is lifted g0; a two-point wedge is translated in the tilt plane so that both wedge gaps equal g0. Poses released in the air (E, C) are unchanged. The shift is recorded per condition and is part of the scored trajectory: displacement and drop are measured from the shifted start, so the settling onto the contacts appears in the deviation columns.
known_limits: the rest gap is not a penetration: the non-penetration check passes by construction and the selection tie-break 'lowest penetration' is 0 for every candidate, so ties fall to declared order. The gap shows in the deviation columns (for example the final centre height of a seated peg) and is reported as rest gap per condition and as a fraction of the clearance
with d_hat = 30 um the gap is about 9 % of the 0.3-mm clearance and about 27 % of the 0.1-mm clearance; results at 0.1 mm are flagged
candidate 1 (d_hat 10 mm) is of the size of the bore radius; it is run as the literal B = 1 and is not expected to be meaningful
the R = 8 rollouts of a condition share one IPC scene (one Newton solve) and are numerically coupled
libuipc aborts the process on a diverged solve; the condition's rollouts are then non-finite and count as invalid
not_applicable: engine-reported contact depth and the spurious-contact count (reported as 0)
block R support-edge diagnostic (two steps after release the peg is still outside the barrier)

run_plan.structure: task_runner_sop.md phases: B = 1 audit, B = 5 selection on a few selection-only conditions, then the frozen configuration on the disjoint frozen matrix. Candidates are never run on the frozen matrix.

1_selection.why_these: three labelled conditions at the dev clearance (0.3 mm), each close to an analytic boundary and together pulling in opposite directions: a wedge that must slide in and seat (0.8 mu*), a wedge that must stay (1.25 x unique-hold edge), a rim rest just outside the stability threshold (x1.10). A configuration that is too soft or too sticky fails at least one of them.
1_selection.selection_rule: most correct rollouts summed over the selection conditions (k / R per condition, so an unstable condition counts by its share); then fewest inadmissible rests; then lowest mean pose-based peak penetration over the selection conditions; then declared order. A candidate that is not runnable at the task time step is skipped. B = k is the same rule over the first k candidates (kept in the raw artifact); B = 1 is the native default, B = 5 the frozen configuration. Deviations are not used.
1_selection.smoke: code smoke tests may use these selection conditions only; no frozen condition is run before the configuration is frozen
1_selection.candidates: the five declared configurations of the engine, in the order of candidates.<engine>.declared_order

2_frozen_matrix.conditions: every condition with role = 'frozen' (same clearance as selection: transfer to other poses / frictions / loads; clearances 0.1 and 1.0 mm: transfer to unseen geometry). Reported separately for the two groups.
configurations: native default (B = 1), unless it is the winner

3_robustness.dt: frozen B = 5 at dt = 0.25 and 1.0 ms on the robustness subset (a configuration that violates an engine limit at that dt is recorded as not runnable, not retuned)
3_robustness.repeat: frozen B = 5 run a second time on the robustness subset to expose run-to-run non-determinism

run_plan.4_attribution_control: supplementary. MuJoCo only, selection conditions only: candidate 3's solref and solimp with the native integrator / cone / solver, to separate stiffness from solver options

roles.main_result: phases 1 and 2. Each engine is evaluated with its own frozen B = 5 configuration (and its native default, B = 1) on the whole frozen matrix, every block including I. All conclusions are drawn from this.
roles.supplementary: phases 3, 4 and 5. They explain the main result (why a block came out as it did). They never change a candidate, the frozen configuration, a verdict, a deviation or any block result, and they are reported in a separate section.

5_hardness.purpose: supplementary. States how hard each declared candidate is, how hard each engine's contact can be made at a given time step, and what time step an engine needs for a given hardness. Information only.

cell.note: 32-mm centred drop; not a scored condition

5_hardness.observable: pose-based peak base penetration during the drop (mm). Damping check: after first base contact the peg stays within 0.05 mm of its final height from 0.3 s onward.
5_hardness.a_candidate_hardness: every declared candidate of every engine at the task time step (0.5 ms): peak base penetration and stop time after first contact.

b_reachable_hardness_vs_time_step.method: per engine and dt, bisect the engine's stiffness parameter for the smallest peak base penetration that passes the damping check (SAP: ke, with tau the smallest of {1.5, 3, 6, 12, 24} ms that passes; MuJoCo: solref timeconst >= 2 dt, other options as candidates 2-5)
reported: per engine and dt: the smallest reachable peak base penetration
per engine: the largest tested dt at which 0.15, 0.3, 0.6, 1.2 mm is reachable (or 'not reachable in the tested range')
wall time per simulated second of this cell at each dt (same GPU for all engines)

5_hardness.genesis_ipc: penetration is 0 by construction; reported instead: the rest gap above the base for each candidate, and wall time per simulated second at each dt
5_hardness.not_done: no scored condition is re-run at another hardness or time step for this test

reuse_of_v8_pilot_runs.rule: a run made under strict-v8-draft is reused without re-running when the candidate parameters, condition, seed, time step and runner code are identical. The artifact keeps its v8 manifest sha256 and is re-tabulated under the v9 criterion (every v9 column is already in its per-rollout rows). Experiments already made are not changed.
reuse_of_v8_pilot_runs.sap_warp: all pilot runs: selection of the five candidates, frozen B = 5 (candidate 4; the v9 selection rule freezes the same one), frozen B = 1, robustness.
reuse_of_v8_pilot_runs.mujoco_warp: selection of candidates 1, 3 and 5; frozen B = 1; the attribution control. The pilot's frozen B = 5 and robustness runs used candidate 5 and are reused only if the v9 selection freezes candidate 5.
new_runs: MuJoCo Warp: selection of candidates 2 and 4 (2 x 3 conditions); then frozen B = 5 (61 conditions) and robustness (24) for the v9 winner unless it is candidate 5. On the pilot's three candidates alone the v9 rule picks candidate 3 (23 of 24 rollouts).
Genesis IPC: everything (selection 15, frozen B = 5 61, frozen B = 1 61, robustness 24)

cell_runs_per_engine.supplementary_hardness: one drop cell: 5 candidates per engine, plus a stiffness bisection at 5 time steps (no condition runs)

reports.0_selection_table: per engine: all five candidates on the selection conditions (k / R and verdict per condition, rollout total, pose-based penetration), the frozen index for B = 1 .. 5 and what changed from B = 1.
reports.1_hardness_correctness_curve: supplementary, descriptive: outcome on the three selection conditions versus the pose-based penetration measured on those conditions, for the candidates of every engine on one axis.
reports.2_frozen_result: MAIN RESULT. B = 1 and frozen B = 5 on the frozen matrix, one table per block (E, W, R, I, C), same-clearance and unseen-clearance groups: per condition k / R, verdict and the deviation columns; per block the counts correct / unstable / wrong, the rollout total and, per deviation column, the median and the worst condition. Inadmissible rests on every condition including the unlabelled ones. No cross-block total.
reports.3_boundary_location: W: per engine and clearance, which of the five friction points slide / hold and whether the flip lies inside admissible_flip_band [mu*, unique-hold lower edge]. Non-monotone sweeps are flagged. R: the offset interval containing the flip, and its distance from the analytic threshold in mm and in units of the clearance.
reports.4_invariance: I is reported in the main result like every other block (frozen B = 5 and B = 1). In addition, descriptively: the largest gravity scale (1, 8, 64) and mass scale at which the outcome still equals the base cell's; whether the mirror image gives the same outcome.
reports.5_mechanism_diagnostics: R: innermost peg contact point two steps after release versus the analytic support edge (support-edge error, mm). All blocks: spurious-contact count; pose-based versus engine-reported penetration; for MuJoCo the residual against kappa * v * timeconst.
reports.6_robustness: supplementary: dt = 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 ms and the repeat run on the robustness subset.
reports.7_hardness: supplementary: the hardness of every declared candidate; reachable peak base penetration versus dt for every engine on one axis; the dt each engine needs for 0.15 / 0.3 / 0.6 / 1.2 mm; cost per simulated second.

not_covered: Geometric interference (a peg larger than the bore being squeezed in): with a flat-ended peg and a sharp-edged bore the block is face-on-face, so it cannot probe bore-wall penetration. It needs a tapered or chamfered asset; block L (load scaling of self-locked holds) is the available substitute.
Slide-phase trajectory reference, restitution, impact force and duration (levels 2-4): out of scope by decision; restitution is covered by the bounce tasks.

Free fall only: no gripper compliance, no applied insertion force, no controller. Impact at 0.2-0.8 m/s is not how a robot inserts; static penetration under a 10-50 N push is not exercised except through gravity scaling in block I. A compliantly held, driven insertion is the planned next task.

W resolution: the rigid model itself is non-unique over a factor 2-5 in mu between mu* and the unique-hold edge, so a flip anywhere inside that band is consistent with theory. Only R has a sharp analytic boundary.
No real data: every reference is the rigid-body Coulomb limit.

Blindness: clearances 0.1 and 0.3 mm were first run in the v8 pilot, and the blocks were designed knowing v6's findings (SAP's rim support gap, MuJoCo's soft-contact behaviour). v9's candidate, selection and reporting rules were written after the v8 pilot results of SAP and MuJoCo had been seen (MuJoCo's 0.6-mm rung with 7 of 8 rim rollouts correct lost to the 1.2-mm rung with 0 of 8; both engines 10 / 10 on W with different creep), and MuJoCo's two new candidates were chosen after that pilot. Conditions, labels and thresholds are unchanged from v8. This is disclosed, not removable.

No single score: this revision defines no cross-block total, no block weights and no ranking by deviation. 17 of the 46 labelled frozen conditions are rim-support cases (R 11, I 3, E 3), so any unweighted total would mostly measure that one mechanism.

Hardness is not matched: engines are compared each at its own selected configuration. A comparison at equal hardness is not part of the main result; the supplementary hardness test only states what equal hardness would require.
implementation_required: socket_v8_common.execute: take the candidates from the manifest's declared lists (no ladder calibration before selection); selection_key: correct rollouts first
SAP and MuJoCo runners: build candidates from candidates.<engine>.declared_order; MuJoCo 'runnable' check per candidate and dt
result tables: per-block main table with k / R, verdict and the deviation columns (all columns are already in the per-rollout rows)
supplementary hardness test: candidate hardness and the stiffness bisection at each dt
Genesis IPC runner (scripts/genesis/run_socket_v8_genesis_ipc.py): written, not yet tested; its selection key must follow this file
